unit.why: A single narrative about R. Neta of Chelm: his self-taught path, a sign-test in the winter forest, his habit of stripping rival tsaddikim of their spiritual levels, and his encounter with the Seer of Lublin.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהרה"ק ר׳ נטע זצ"ל מחעלם
stories.summary_en: R. Neta of Chelm, self-taught, tests his path by casting off his clothes in a winter forest and they are brought back to him; he later strips tsaddikim he disapproves of of their levels, but when he slips into the Seer of Lublin's third Sabbath meal in the dark, the Seer senses him, warns him off and they end up rejoicing together.
